description: ABOUT JUDGE DAN WILSON Judge Dan Wilson is a fourth-generation Montanan. His great-grandfather homesteaded near Malta in 1913. His grandfather continued farming the land, raised a family in Malta, and, as a respected member of the community, served as a Phillips County judge when Dan was a young boy.
